preconditions.description: The number of problems n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of experienced teams k is between 1 and 4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each element in the problem knowledge matrix is either 0 or 1.
The number of lines in the input is n + 1.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == k for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n lines contains exactly k integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().upper() == 'YES' if any(all(knowledge.count(1) <= len(knowledge) // 2 for knowledge in zip(*[list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])) for r in range(1, n + 1) for combination in combinations(range(n), r)) else stdout.strip().upper() == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if there exists a non-empty subset of problems such that each team knows at most half of the selected problems, otherwise 'NO'.
